request.text:
--//ma_so_thue, ten_kh, ten_kh2, dia_chi, nguoi_lh, e_mail, ten_nh_kh1, ten_nh_kh2, ten_nh_kh3, home_page, ten_nh, ten_tt, gioi_han_no, ky_han_no, ten_nvbh, phong_kd, fax, so_tk IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#v') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #v; IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#lslncuocgoi') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #lslncuocgoi;
SELECT a.ma_so_thue, b.ten_kh [!ten_kh], b.ten_kh2 [!ten_kh2], b.dia_chi [!dia_chi], b.nguoi_lh [nguoi_lh], b.e_mail [!e_mail], b.ten_nh_kh1 [!ten_nh_kh1], b.ten_nh_kh2 [!ten_nh_kh2], b.ten_nh_kh3 [!ten_nh_kh3], b.home_page [!home_page], b.ma_nh, b.ma_tt, ISNULL(b.gioi_han_no,0) [!gioi_han_no], ISNULL(b.ky_han_no,0) [!ky_han_no], a.ma_nvbh, ISNULL(b.phong_kd,0) [!phong_kh], b.fax [!fax], b.so_tk [!so_tk], cast('' as nvarchar(255)) as ma_plkh into #v FROM cskh0 a JOIN (select a.ma_so_thue, a.ten_kh, a.ten_kh2, a.dia_chi, a.nguoi_lh, a.e_mail, nh1.ten_nh ten_nh_kh1, nh2.ten_nh ten_nh_kh2,nh3.ten_nh ten_nh_kh3, a.home_page, a.ma_nh, a.ma_tt, a.gioi_han_no, a.ky_han_no, a.phong_kd, a.fax, a.so_tk from dmkh0 a LEFT JOIN dmnh nh1 on a.nh_kh1 = nh1.ma_nh and nh1.ma_loai_nh = 'KH1' LEFT JOIN dmnh nh2 on a.nh_kh2 = nh2.ma_nh and nh2.ma_loai_nh = 'KH2' LEFT JOIN dmnh nh3 on a.nh_kh3 = nh3.ma_nh and nh3.ma_loai_nh = 'KH3') b on a.ma_so_thue = b.ma_so_thue WHERE a.ma_so_thue = @ma_so_thue
SELECT ma_so_thue, ma_plkh, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ma_so_thue ORDER BY line DESC) AS RowNum into #lslncuocgoi FROM lslncuocgoi a where exists(select 1 from #v where ma_so_thue = a.ma_so_thue); UPDATE #v set ma_plkh = f.ma_plkh from #v a join #lslncuocgoi f on a.ma_so_thue = f.ma_so_thue
SELECT a.*, a.ma_nvbh [!ma_nvbh], c.ten_kh [!ten_nvbh], d.ten_tt [!ten_tt], b.ten_plkh [!ten_plkh], e.ten_nh [!ten_nh] from #v a left join dmploaikh b on a.ma_plkh = b.ma_plkh left join dmkh c on a.ma_nvbh = c.ma_kh and nv_yn = 1 left join dmtt d on a.ma_tt = d.ma_tt left join dmnganhang e on a.ma_nh = e.ma_nh
